The engine inside

Water reimagined

In May 2014, STEALTH technology reached its first major breakthrough: a reconstruction process built around ORP shifts, millivolt energy, active hydrogen, and deeply clustered water behavior.

  • Step 1: Purification

    STEALTH uses three super filters to strip contaminants from municipal source water, targeting chemicals, heavy metals, microplastics, chlorine, chloramine, fluoride, herbicides, lead, mercury, nitrates, pharmaceuticals, and more.

  • Step 2: Bypass miracle

    While contaminants are filtered out, naturally occurring beneficial minerals are allowed to remain in the water, including magnesium, potassium, and calcium.

  • Step 3: Reconstruct

    Filtered water enters electrically charged platinum and titanium plate chambers where millivolt energy is used to further polish the water and separate rejected output from the high-density drinking line.

  • Step 4: Supercharge finish

    The final stage is designed around ORP shifts, active hydrogen, and clustered water behavior to create a crisp, mineral-balanced finish.

Filtration stages

Stage 1 — Strip: 3-stage super filtration
Stage 2 — Bypass: beneficial minerals remain
Stage 3 — Reconstruct: charged plate chambers
Stage 4 — Zap: millivolt polishing
Stage 5 — Cluster: active hydrogen line
Stage 6 — Balance: final mineral profile
